title: Symmetric Tree
statement: Return true when the tree is a mirror image of itself about its centre line.
hints: This is not the same as comparing a tree with itself. You need a mirrored comparison.
Write a helper taking TWO nodes and asking whether they are mirrors of each other.
Two nodes mirror when their values match AND left mirrors the other right, and right mirrors the other left. Start it on root.left and root.right.
